newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai says to ship 40 mln Tamagotchis by Mar 1998.
newsitem.headline: Bandai says to ship 40 mln Tamagotchis by Mar 1998.

text.p: Japanese toy maker Bandai Co Ltd said on Friday that accumulated shipments of its runaway hit "Tamagotchi" virtual pet toy would reach 40 million units worldwide by the year ending March 1998.
That would bring the accumulated sales of Tamagotchis and related products to 50 billion yen for the same period.
"We revised our previous forecast. We expect to ship 20 million units in Japan and 20 million units in North America, Europe and Asia combined," a Bandai spokeswoman said.
Tamagotchi is an electronic chicken-like figure on a liquid crystal display that is fed and groomed by pressing buttons.
Bandai, which launched the toy last November, said in April it expected to ship 13 million units in Japan by the end of March 1998.
Domestic sales in Japan are expected to total 30 billion yen through March 1998, with additional sales expected for Tamagotchi-related goods, such as T-shirts and stationery, she said.
The spokeswoman also said Bandai would consign production to factories in Southeast Asia to meet its shipping targets.
Tamagotchis are currently produced only at a Bandai factory in China.
